subject: Hospitality
title: Competitive Rate Shopping
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Competitive Rate Shopping.

hook.text: Hotels check competitor prices dozens of times daily using automated 'rate shopping' tools. Knowing the rival's price is.

buildup.text: Tools like OTA Insight and RateGain scrape competitor rates from booking sites and present them in real-time dashboards.

discovery.text: If a competitor drops rates, a hotel must decide: match the price to stay competitive, or hold firm to protect margins.

twist.text: Matching competitors can trigger price wars where everyone loses. Smart revenue managers compete on value, not just rate.

climax.text: Rate shopping changed hotel pricing from a weekly decision to a continuous, data-driven process happening around the clock.

punchline.text: Know your rival's price before your guest does. Rate shopping never sleeps.

quiz.question: What is a risk of constantly matching competitor rates?
options: It can trigger price wars where everyone's margins suffer
